Explainer diagram for the 'The Peptide Approach to Wrinkle Reduction' block on /pages/fine-lines-wrinkles — templates/page.fine-lines-wrinkles.json, section `content`, block `approach`. Malcolm, 2026-08-26: a medical / luxury-beauty explainer to sit alongside the one being chosen for the `causes` block above it, with the actives understood before anything is drawn.

WHAT IT REPLACES: skingenetix-copper-peptide-serum-dropper-detail.jpg — a borrowed dropper macro from the COPPER PEPTIDE set. Two faults, not one: a product photograph argues nothing about the biology, and this page's peptides are Acetyl Hexapeptide-8 and Matrixyl 3000, so the current picture illustrates a different ingredient on a different page's colour.

=== THE ACTIVES, AND WHAT EACH ONE ACTUALLY DOES ===

The block names two peptide behaviours and one combined outcome. Read against the three product blocks below it on the same page, they resolve to specific molecules:

1  'Signal peptides support the skin's natural collagen activity' = MATRIXYL 3000, two matrikines. Palmitoyl pentapeptide-4 (pal-KTTKS) is a fragment of collagen's OWN propeptide: its presence in the dermis is the message 'collagen has broken down here', and fibroblasts read that message and synthesise replacement. Palmitoyl tetrapeptide-7 quiets the inflammatory signalling that drives ongoing matrix degradation. The palmitoyl tail is the part that carries them through the lipid barrier. The page's own Matrixyl block states this plainly — 'mimics signals released when collagen breaks down. It activates fibroblasts to produce new collagen types I, III, and IV, plus elastin and fibronectin.' SO THE PICTURE OF THIS IS NOT AN ACTIVE THAT REPAIRS FIBRE DIRECTLY. It is a message arriving, a CELL receiving it, and the cell producing new fibre. The fibroblast is the hinge of the whole mechanism and is the thing most likely to be left out.

2  'Other peptides help visibly relax the look of expression lines' = ACETYL HEXAPEPTIDE-8. Its described mechanism is mimicry of the N-terminal of SNAP-25, competing in the SNARE complex at the neuromuscular junction and reducing the acetylcholine release that drives contraction.

3  Hyaluronic acid runs through both products — 'immediate plumping plus long-term rebuilding' on the Matrixyl block, a triple HA complex on the day gel-cream, and the causes copy above notes HA production falls roughly 50% by the 40s. It is the water in the matrix, not a fibre.

=== THE ONE DECISION THAT SHAPES EVERY SLOT: NO NEUROMUSCULAR JUNCTION IS DRAWN ===

Mechanism 2 above has a vivid picture attached to it — a nerve terminal, vesicles, a synaptic cleft, a muscle fibre — and it is barred from every slot in this wave. Three independent reasons, any one of which is sufficient:

  * THE COPY DOES NOT MAKE THAT CLAIM. It says the peptide helps 'visibly RELAX THE LOOK OF expression lines'. That hedge is deliberate and it is a cosmetic claim. A drawn nerve releasing vesicles onto a muscle asserts a pharmacological action ON MUSCLE, which is a drug claim. A picture can make a claim the text carefully avoided, and on a live storefront that is real exposure.
  * IT READS AS NEEDLE-FREE BOTOX, which is the exact comparison the copy distances itself from in its own first paragraph ('In-clinic treatments act on muscle movement but require repeat appointments'). The frame would argue against its own caption.
  * IT BREAKS THE SET. The causes brief for the block directly above already negates `no muscle fibre, no tendon, no bone` for this page, and the two blocks are read together.

So the 'relax' half of the claim is carried by THE SURFACE — the folded outer layers easing their pleat and the crease shallowing — never by depicting the muscle that made it. That is also the only part of the effect a customer can actually see.

=== STYLE, INHERITED VERBATIM FROM THE CAUSES BRIEF SO THE TWO BLOCKS READ AS A SET ===

block-fine-lines-causes-explainer.json and this file must produce two pictures that look like consecutive figures from one document. Same soft glossy CGI, luminous and dreamy, high-key on a pale hazy gradient. Same block of skin in cross-section at a low three-quarter angle so top surface and cut face are both visible. Same three legible strata: a finely textured outer layer, a stack of flattened rounded translucent cells, a deep zone of long wavy glossy fibre bundles. Same soft desaturated PEACH-CREAM tissue and soft desaturated TEAL-BLUE glassy fibre. Same shallow depth of field with the far edge dissolving into haze.

Note this palette follows what Malcolm SELECTED on the copper-peptide and Matrixyl research sets, not the written r3 spec (which called for vivid Clinical blue 014EB1) and not the concern-to-colour map in 03-art-direction-and-briefs.md §1.2 (which binds Fine Lines & Wrinkles to Pearl grey D8D6D4). Pearl grey is the PRODUCT-TILE colour for this concern; the explainer family has its own established palette and the two blocks on this page must match each other before they match a table. Deliberate, and recorded here so it is not 'corrected' later.

=== THE HOUSE 'ARRIVING ACTIVE' VOCABULARY IS UNLOCKED HERE — THIS IS THE INVERSION ===

The causes brief BARS translucent spheres, descending light shafts and starburst glints, because a picture of an active arriving under the heading 'What Causes Fine Lines & Wrinkles?' argues the opposite of its text. This block is where that vocabulary belongs and it is the whole reason the two frames will not look interchangeable. Spheres, descending light and glints at the point of arrival are all permitted and are removed from the negatives.

What stays barred: COPPER, GOLD, BRASS, BRONZE and AMBER. Copper belongs to /pages/copper-peptide-research, and amber cross-links are the visual signature of the GLYCATION concept in the causes wave sitting immediately above this block. Either would make this page argue something it does not mean.

=== NEW FIBRE MUST BE DISTINGUISHABLE FROM OLD, OR THE PICTURE ARGUES NOTHING ===

The failure mode specific to this brief is a frame of uniformly healthy tissue. Healthy tissue is not an argument; it is a texture. Every slot must hold a legible difference between what was there and what is new — fresh fibre brighter, springier, more saturated and more evenly spaced than the old dull slack fibre it is weaving into, and a residual depleted zone left visible so the change has something to be measured against. Judge every candidate on that difference first and on beauty second.

=== CENTRE-SAFE COMPOSITION — MEASURED IN THE LIVE DOM, 2026-08-26 ===

Measured by reading grid-template-rows off the live .media-with-text, and again with the img heights forced to 0 to see what the text alone wants. The `approach` block is the THIRD row, and unlike the `causes` block above it, it is IMAGE-DRIVEN at most widths:

  390  -> 350 x 350  (1.000)  stacked, no crop
  1024 -> 452 x 556  (0.813)  TEXT-DRIVEN — text alone wants 556 and gets it
  1280 -> 580 x 580  (1.000)  image-driven, text alone wants only 528
  1440 -> 660 x 660  (1.000)  image-driven, text alone wants 514
  1920 -> 708 x 708  (1.000)  image-driven, text alone wants 514

So a square master is delivered WHOLE at every width except a band around 1024, where object-fit: cover fills the height and takes about 9.4% off each side. Much gentler than the causes block, which loses up to 44% of its width at the same width. Still: keep the event in the central band and leave the outer tenth of each side as pale haze that can be lost without cost.

MASTER IS SQUARE at 2048x2048, and that is not a stylistic choice. `media-with-text` is a CSS grid with one row per block and `.media-with-text__media` carries no aspect-ratio of its own, so the master's own intrinsic aspect SETS the row height — the measurements above show this block is image-driven at 1280 and up, meaning a non-square master here would visibly change the row and break the rhythm against its five siblings. This has now been learned three times on this store.

CLASS B, no reference images attached — the r3, Matrixyl and causes sets Malcolm selected were all generated class B with the style carried entirely in the prompt.

All six suppliers, two candidates each — rule 1. FLUX.2 returns one per call regardless and is under-represented by design; it also invents printed graduation digits on anything glassware-like, so check its candidates at full size. Remember `set -a` before sourcing credentials, or five of six suppliers fail silently and the run still exits 0.

slots.title: A · the signal reaches the cell and the cell answers — new fibre spun into the depleted zone
slots.prompt:
Soft three-dimensional medical explainer illustration in the style of premium skincare advertising: smooth glossy CGI, luminous and dreamy, high-key on a pale hazy gradient background. Square format.

A block of skin is shown in cross-section, seen from a low three-quarter angle so both its top surface and its cut face are visible, occupying the lower two thirds of the frame and centred. Three strata are clearly legible from top to bottom: a thin outer layer with a fine irregular texture of soft interlocking plates; beneath it a stack of two or three rows of flattened rounded translucent cells; and below that an open deeper zone filled with long wavy bundles of glossy fibre running horizontally. The tissue is a soft desaturated peach-cream, warm and pale. The fibre bundles are a soft desaturated teal-blue, glassy and translucent.

A SMALL GROUP OF TINY TRANSLUCENT ROUNDED FORMS IS DESCENDING INTO THE BLOCK at its centre, a loose vertical trail of them passing down through the outer layer and between the rows of cells, each one glassy and softly glowing with a pale cool light, growing smaller and fainter as they go deeper. Where the trail meets the deep fibre zone there is a soft luminous bloom.

AT THE CENTRE OF THAT DEEP ZONE SITS ONE ROUNDED CELL, larger than the cells above, smooth and translucent, its interior faintly lit from within as though it has just received something. THE CELL IS PRODUCING NEW FIBRE: several fresh strands emerge from its surface and reach outward into the surrounding space, and these new strands are unmistakably different from the old ones around them — brighter, more saturated teal, smooth and springy, evenly formed, catching a clean highlight along their length. They curve outward and begin to weave in among the older bundles.

The older bundles they are joining are visibly spent: thinner, duller, greyed toward the edges of the frame, slack and unevenly spaced with open gaps between them. Toward the outer parts of the deep zone that depletion is still plainly there and untouched, so the new growth at the centre has something to be measured against. Directly above, the surface still carries a soft shallow valley, but the cell rows beneath it are beginning to lift.

Soft diffuse light, no hard shadow, shallow depth of field, the far edge of the block dissolving into pale haze. The outer tenth of the frame on the left and on the right is empty pale haze. Glossy, luminous, immaculate, calm and clinical.

slots.title: B · the matrix beneath the crease is dense again and the surface valley has eased
slots.prompt:
Soft three-dimensional medical explainer illustration in the style of premium skincare advertising: smooth glossy CGI, luminous and dreamy, high-key on a pale hazy gradient background. Square format.

A block of skin is shown in cross-section, seen from a low three-quarter angle so both its top surface and its cut face are visible, occupying the lower two thirds of the frame and centred. Three strata are clearly legible: a thin finely textured outer layer; beneath it a stack of two or three rows of flattened rounded translucent cells; and below that an open deeper zone of long wavy glossy fibre bundles running horizontally. The tissue is a soft desaturated peach-cream. The fibre is a soft desaturated teal-blue, glassy and translucent.

THE CENTRE OF THE DEEP ZONE IS FULL AGAIN. There the bundles are thick, densely packed, evenly spaced and springy, saturated teal with a clean highlight running along each one, crossing and supporting one another in a close continuous weave. A few of the strands in that dense centre are brighter and smoother than their neighbours — plainly newer, threaded in among the older ones rather than replacing them.

DIRECTLY ABOVE THAT RESTORED CENTRE THE SURFACE HAS EASED. Where a deep crease once cut into the top face there is now only a soft shallow dip, its walls opened out and rounded, the outer layer smooth and unbroken across it with no sharp fold and no pleat. The rows of cells beneath it, which were compressed and sagging, are decompressed and running level again, carried on the matrix below.

TOWARD ONE END OF THE BLOCK THE OLD STATE IS STILL VISIBLE and is what makes the change legible: there the fibre remains thin, dull, slack and widely spaced, and the surface above it still sinks into a deeper, narrower crease with the layers buckling into it. Between that end and the restored centre the change is a slow smooth gradient across one continuous piece of tissue — never a line, never an edge, never a seam.

Soft diffuse light, no hard shadow, shallow depth of field, the far edge of the block dissolving into pale haze. The outer tenth of the frame on the left and on the right is empty pale haze. Glossy, luminous, immaculate, calm and clinical.

slots.title: C · both claims in one frame — one stream sinks to the cell and rebuilds, the other eases the folded surface
slots.prompt:
Soft three-dimensional medical explainer illustration in the style of premium skincare advertising: smooth glossy CGI, luminous and dreamy, high-key on a pale hazy gradient background. Square format.

A block of skin is shown in cross-section, seen from a low three-quarter angle so both its top surface and its cut face are visible, occupying the lower two thirds of the frame and centred. Three strata are legible: a thin finely textured outer layer; beneath it two or three rows of flattened rounded translucent cells; and below that an open deeper zone of long wavy glossy fibre bundles. The tissue is soft desaturated peach-cream; the fibre is soft desaturated teal-blue, glassy and translucent.

TINY TRANSLUCENT ROUNDED FORMS ARE ENTERING THE BLOCK THROUGH ITS TOP SURFACE, glassy and faintly luminous, and once inside they divide into TWO DISTINCT MOVEMENTS that are easy to tell apart at a glance.

THE FIRST MOVEMENT GOES DOWN. A slender vertical trail of them continues deep through the cell rows into the fibre zone, where one larger rounded translucent cell sits softly lit from within. Fresh fibre is emerging from that cell into the surrounding space — brighter, smoother, more saturated teal than the old bundles nearby, evenly formed and springy, curving out to weave in among thinner duller strands that are plainly older.

THE SECOND MOVEMENT SPREADS SIDEWAYS. Just beneath the outer layer, at the shallow depth where the surface folds, another group of the same little forms drifts outward to left and right and settles along the underside of the skin, glowing gently there in a soft horizontal band. WHERE THEY HAVE SPREAD, THE FOLDED SURFACE IS EASING: the outer layer above them, which was pleated and gathered into a tight crease, has opened out into a soft shallow rounded dip, its pleats relaxed and smoothed, the tension visibly gone out of it.

The two movements happen in one continuous piece of tissue at two different depths and are connected by the same trail entering at the top. Toward the outer parts of the block both the fibre depletion and the deeper folding are still visible and untreated.

Soft diffuse light, no hard shadow, shallow depth of field, the far edge of the block dissolving into pale haze. The outer tenth of the frame on the left and on the right is empty pale haze. Glossy, luminous, immaculate, calm and clinical.

slots.title: D · fibre plus water — the rebuilt matrix swollen and plumped, the surface lifted level
slots.prompt:
Soft three-dimensional medical explainer illustration in the style of premium skincare advertising: smooth glossy CGI, luminous and dreamy, high-key on a pale hazy gradient background. Square format.

A block of skin is shown in cross-section, seen from a low three-quarter angle so both its top surface and its cut face are visible, occupying the lower two thirds of the frame and centred. Three strata are legible: a thin finely textured outer layer; beneath it two or three rows of flattened rounded translucent cells, here full and rounded rather than flattened; and below that an open deeper zone of long wavy glossy fibre bundles. The tissue is soft desaturated peach-cream; the fibre is soft desaturated teal-blue, glassy and translucent.

THE DEEP ZONE HOLDS BOTH FIBRE AND WATER. The fibre bundles through the centre are thick, springy and evenly spaced, saturated teal with clean highlights, several of them noticeably brighter and smoother than the rest and clearly newer. BETWEEN AND AROUND THEM THE SPACE IS NO LONGER EMPTY: it is filled with a soft water-clear translucent substance, glassy and faintly blue, gathered into rounded swelling volumes that press gently outward against the fibres and catch the light like held water. The whole deep zone looks swollen, buoyant and heavy with moisture.

BECAUSE THE ZONE BELOW HAS SWELLED, THE SURFACE ABOVE IS LIFTED. The cell rows are plump and rounded and sit level; the outer layer is drawn smooth, taut and gently domed across the centre of the block, its fine surface texture stretched flat and even, with no crease and no fold anywhere across it.

TOWARD ONE END OF THE BLOCK THE CONTRAST IS KEPT: there the fibre is thin and dull, the spaces between the bundles are dry and empty, the cell rows are flattened and the surface sinks into a soft crease. The change from that end to the swollen centre is a slow smooth gradient across one continuous piece of tissue, with no line and no edge between them.

Soft diffuse light, no hard shadow, shallow depth of field, the far edge of the block dissolving into pale haze. The outer tenth of the frame on the left and on the right is empty pale haze. Glossy, luminous, immaculate, calm and clinical.
